name: Amgen
description: Amgen discovers, makes and sells biologic medicines (large-molecule drugs made in living cells) for bone health, heart disease, cancer, inflammation, kidney disease and rare disease. It reports one operating segment, human therapeutics. About 96 percent of revenue is product sales, and about 73 percent of product sales are in the US. Money comes from selling drugs still under patent (Repatha, Evenity, Tezspire, Blincyto) while older franchises face biosimilar and Medicare price pressure (Prolia, Enbrel, Otezla). The remainder is corporate-partner revenue and royalties.

employees.note: Approximately 31,500 staff members in over 50 countries, about 13,000 outside the US (FY2025 10-K)

businessLines.name: Human therapeutics (Amgen's only operating segment)
businessLines.how: Prescription drugs sold at list price less rebates, mostly to wholesalers and pharmacies, with repeat demand from chronic patients. Product sales grew 10% in 2025 on volume +13% offset by net selling price -3%; a smaller part is corporate-partner milestones and royalties (other revenues).
businessLines.description: All Amgen products and partner income are one reported segment.
